name: Wicker Brothers Inc
old_description: At Wicker Brothers Custom Fabrication, we pride ourselves on being a fully equipped fabrication shop, ready to handle a wide range of projects, big or small. From design and prototyping to final installation, our team is committed to delivering high-quality results every step of the way.
about:
Wicker Brothers Inc operates a custom metal fabrication shop in Florence, Mississippi. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources.

The shop provides design and prototyping, welding and repairs, field repairs and installation, and manufacturing of custom metal parts. Its equipment lineup includes three hydraulic press brakes (175-ton, 200-ton, 75-ton), two hydraulic shears (10-foot and 12-foot), multiple hydraulic ironworkers, two horizontal bandsaws, plate rolls, a pipe bender, angle and tube rolling equipment, a spot welder, TIG, MIG, and laser welding machines, belt sanders, a Timesaver wide belt sander, an Amada 3 kW fiber laser, a Messer high-definition plasma cutter, a Calypso waterjet, a CNC horizontal bandsaw, a 10' x 10' x 25' powder coating oven, industrial sandblasting pots, three lathes, and three mills. The company also operates 15 fully equipped service trucks for on-site work. It states it can produce anything from a single custom part to thousands of components.

Wicker Brothers serves customers in the medical and hospital sector, restaurants, and shipping companies, according to its website.

The company emphasizes its ability to keep every production step in-house, which it says gives it strict control over due dates and delivery schedules. It also highlights a certified drafting and design team that consults on projects from concept to completion.
